name: Vegetarian
overview: Scripture reveals that God's original provision for mankind was plant-based foods, as seen in Genesis 1:29 where God grants every herb and fruit for food. After the Flood, God expanded this provision to include all moving creatures for meat, while still acknowledging the earlier plant-based diet (Genesis 9:3). The book of Daniel highlights personal conviction in dietary choices, as Daniel chose to abstain from the king's meat to avoid defilement (Daniel 1:8). Additionally, prophetic visions in Isaiah depict a peaceful creation where carnivorous animals coexist harmlessly with their prey, symbolizing restoration and harmony rather than dietary prescriptions (Isaiah 11:6; 65:25). These passages collectively show that vegetarianism, while not mandated, is rooted in God's original design and can be a matter of personal faithfulness.
